items.title: Blue Jet Healthcare among 4 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On July 29, four stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period, and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward price momentum.

items.title: Kaynes Technology among 9 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 29, nine stocks in the Nifty500 pack that gained over 5% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Xtranet Technologies set for stock market debut today; GMP hints at 11% listing gains
items.description: Ahead of the listing, Xtranet Technologies is commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around 11%, reflecting positive investor sentiment. Based on the IPO's upper price band of Rs 127 per share, the stock is expected to list at around Rs 142, translating into an estimated gain of nearly 11% over the issue price.

items.title: Stocks in news: Adani Ports, Adani Enterprises, Vedanta Oil & Gas, Asian Paints, 6 others
items.description: Indian stock indices Sensex and Nifty experienced a significant surge on Wednesday.  Several companies reported strong financial results for the June quarter.  Bajaj Housing Finance and MTAR Technologies showed substantial profit growth.  Vedanta Oil & Gas and Vedanta Iron and Steel returned to profitability.  Adani Enterprises, however, reported a net loss despite revenue increases.

items.title: Indo-MIM IPO set for market debut today; GMP signals up to 39% listing gain
items.description: The latest Grey Market Premium (GMP) stands at Rs 190, implying a premium of nearly 39% over the IPO's upper price band of Rs 485 per share. If current grey market trends hold, the stock could debut at around Rs 675 per share.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 8 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: As of July 29, 2026, 18 Nifty 500 stocks closed above their 200-day moving average (DMA). Among them, we highlighted the top eight that gained more than 4%, based on StockEdge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:"

items.title: Adani Ports Q1 net profit rises 10% on overseas growth
items.description: Adani Ports reported a 10.2% profit increase for the June quarter. Higher cargo volumes and international port business fueled this significant growth. Revenue from operations climbed 18.6 percent to ₹10,820.80 crore. The company's international ports business saw revenue surge eighty percent. Domestic ports revenue grew twelve percent as cargo volumes increased.

items.title: Adani Enterprises posts Q1 loss on US govt charge
items.description: Adani Enterprises reported a net loss of ₹1,160 crore for the June quarter. This loss was due to an exceptional charge related to an OFAC settlement. Strong growth in airports and roads businesses boosted operating performance significantly. The company reaffirmed its capital expenditure plans for upcoming fiscal years. Adani Enterprises has no current plans to enter the airline business.

items.title: Rupee rises for the third day to a near 3-week high
items.description: The rupee strengthened for a third consecutive day, reaching a near three-week high. Dollar sales by foreign and state-run banks aided the local currency's climb. Sustained buying in domestic equities and positive foreign investor sentiment supported the rupee. Crude oil prices saw a modest rebound, limiting further rupee gains. The currency is expected to trade within a specific range on Thursday.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty rally over 1% as IT stocks drive broad-based market gains
items.description: Indian stock gauges rose over one percent on Wednesday. Overseas fund flows are expected to shift into local technology companies. The Nifty and Sensex closed higher, reflecting positive investor sentiment. Declining crude oil prices and a stronger rupee also supported market gains. Foreign and domestic institutions were net buyers of shares.

items.title: D-St set for a muted opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
items.description: Indian equity markets opened yesterday with a strong gap-up and extended gains throughout the session.  The Indian Rupee appreciated from lower levels, boosting investor sentiment significantly.  Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers, adding to the positive market momentum.  Analysts suggest the index may head towards key resistance levels soon.  The India VIX, a fear gauge, also saw a notable decline.

items.title: These mid-cap stocks with ‘Strong Buy’ & ‘Buy’ recos can rally over 25%, according to analysts
items.description: The next time uncertainty over the firing of missiles in the Gulf region makes you anxious, remember this: It is not the first time that global markets have witnessed such phases. Similar scenarios have played out in the past; and at particular points of time, it had appeared that everything would crash and the world would come to an end. But the world is more resilient than we think. That said, the probability is high that we will see several such phases till the end of 2028. That is when the cause of much uncertainty will exit his office.

items.title: Motilal Oswal raises mid and smallcap allocation to 50%, stays neutral on Indian equities
items.description: Motilal Oswal Private Wealth favors Indian mid and small-cap stocks. They are increasing allocations to these segments by ten percentage points. The firm suggests a neutral stance on Indian equities overall. Hybrid and large-cap allocations are set at forty percent. Global equities will comprise the remaining ten percent of investments.

items.title: ProTec gets insurance licence; Irdai revamps key guidelines
items.description: ProTec General Insurance will be allowed to undertake general insurance business under the applicable regulatory framework. The four registrations granted so far in calendar 2026 include two general insurers, one health insurer and one reinsurer, Irdai said.

items.title: Axis, Kotak Mahindra raise charges for overseas card transactions
items.description: Axis Bank will increase the DCC fee on its credit cards to 3.5% from 1.5%, effective August 28, 2026, according to the bank's revised terms and conditions. Kotak Mahindra Bank will raise the fee on debit-card transactions to 3.5% plus goods and services tax (GST), from 1% plus GST, effective August 1.

items.title: FCNR(B) surge: Inflows through special window to ease banks’ liquidity pressure
items.description: In the first quarter of FY27, revised liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) norms came into effect, reducing the assumed run-off rate on deposits from non-financial entities such as trusts, limited liability partnerships (LLPs), and partnerships to 40% from 100% earlier. The change lowered projected 30-day cash outflows for banks, providing flexibility to the LCR mandate.
